items.title: Towards In-Parameter Memory Augmentation for Large Language Models
items.summary: This paper proposes updating model parameters to store external knowledge, providing a more efficient alternative to long-context prompting for LLMs that need to retain domain-specific information.

items.summary: The authors introduce procedural graphs to structure LLM agent workflows, preventing common issues like repetitive actions and poor long-term planning in complex task execution.

items.summary: This review examines how LLMs can bridge the gap between fragmented building sensor data and actionable HVAC control, highlighting current deployment challenges and operational readiness.
